spec.name: IT assets
spec.description: Created from the IT asset management template. Hardware Models is the request catalogue; Person is added so approvals can go to the requester's manager.

justification.reason: Part of the Person extension: Approval goes to the requester's manager; the IT asset management template has no people or reporting lines, and Jira user profiles do not expose a manager to automation.

spec.name: Hardware Models
spec.description: Template catalogue of hardware models; employees request one of these.

spec.name: Person
spec.description: Employees and their managers, so approvals go to the manager.

justification.reason: Approval goes to the requester's manager; the IT asset management template has no people or reporting lines, and Jira user profiles do not expose a manager to automation.
alternativesConsidered: An approver group per department: loses "the requester's own manager"
An HR-system integration feeding Approvers directly: possible later, needs an integration
Asking the requester to name the approver: weak control

spec.name: Unit Price
spec.description: Template attribute (whole currency units); compared with the cost threshold.

spec.name: Status
spec.description: Template status. Models that are Inactive or Disposed are hidden from the request form (replaces a separate "Approved" flag).

spec.name: Standard
spec.description: Standard models can be auto-approved under the cost threshold.

justification.reason: The approval rule distinguishes standard from non-standard models; the template has no attribute for that.
alternativesConsidered: A cost threshold alone: loses the rule that non-standard models always need approval
A Model Category per standard set: the template uses categories for model families, not policy
